# Decision record

- ID / title:
- Date:
- Owner / participants:
- Status: proposed / accepted / superseded

## Context and evidence
Link sources and describe the problem or opportunity, including unknowns.

## Options
Compare feasible options against customer value, brand fit, effort, cost and measurement.

## Decision and rationale
Describe the chosen action and why the evidence supports it.

## Consequences and follow-up
Record dependencies, risks, accountable owner and review trigger. Link any superseding decision.
